name: unnamed protagonist (ad07)
source: local SDXL-Turbo generation, styled to match Benjamin's ChatGPT reference batch (paired_ad image showing him with the Puzzle Dog mascot)
note_on_provenance: Unlike the mascot, the human character stills ARE locally generated (SDXL-Turbo, this repo's own ComfyUI), only matched in look to the externally-supplied reference -- no policy exception needed here.
description: male, mid-20s, messy dark brown tousled wavy hair, thick full eyebrows, light stubble, navy-blue pullover hoodie, believable/relatable rather than cartoonish, mildly sarcastic/skeptical energy

generation_params.prompt: cinematic commercial photograph of a young man in his mid twenties, messy dark brown tousled wavy hair, thick full expressive eyebrows, light stubble, wearing a navy-blue pullover hoodie, standing facing camera, neutral to mildly skeptical relaxed expression, soft studio commercial lighting, clean dark background, sharp focus on face, polished high-end advertising photography, contemporary, relatable, vertical portrait composition, full head and shoulders visible
generation_params.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, deformed hands, extra fingers, cartoon, illustration, low quality, blurry face, multiple people, old, child, blonde hair, straight hair

consistency_mechanism: No IP-Adapter/InstantID/PuLID/FaceID nodes are installed on this ComfyUI (verified against inventory/object_info.json). Multi-scene composites (character + mascot together) use TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus with image1=this locked portrait, image2=the mascot reference, both re-encoded as ReferenceLatent conditioning, denoise=1.0, 25 steps, cfg 3 -- see storyboard frames 07/08/09/10. Single-character storyboard frames (04/05/06) are independent SDXL-Turbo txt2img generations from a near-identical text prompt, which introduces minor, accepted identity drift (documented, same category as the Luther project's own camera-angle-edit limitations in knowledge/ltx-2.3-guide/).

superseded.what: An earlier from-scratch character (dark wavy hair, short beard/stubble, blue-gray hoodie) generated before the ChatGPT reference batch arrived
superseded.reason: restyled to match the human shown in Benjamin's chosen ChatGPT reference for visual consistency with the locked mascot's own paired concept art
